# 1. Construct a Contingency Table for Missing Geocode Data by Borough
```{python}
import pandas as pd
import scipy.stats as stats

df['Missing_Geocode'] = df['LATITUDE'].isnull() | df['LONGITUDE'].isnull()

# Create the contingency table
contingency_table = pd.crosstab(df['BOROUGH'], df['Missing_Geocode'])
print(contingency_table)

# Chi-square test
chi2, p, dof, expected = stats.chi2_contingency(contingency_table)
print(f"Chi-Square Statistic: {chi2}, P-value: {p}")

if p < 0.05:
    print("Reject the null hypothesis: Missing geocode data is associated with the borough.")
else:
    print("Fail to reject the null hypothesis: No association between missing geocode data and borough.")
```
# 2. Create Hour Variable and Plot Histogram of Crashes by Hour
```{python}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Convert CRASH TIME to datetime and extract hour
df['CRASH TIME'] = pd.to_datetime(df['CRASH TIME'], format='%H:%M')
df['hour'] = df['CRASH TIME'].dt.hour

# Plot histogram for all data
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.hist(df['hour'], bins=24, alpha=0.7)
plt.xlabel('Hour of Day')
plt.ylabel('Number of Crashes')
plt.title('Number of Crashes by Hour')
plt.xticks(range(24))
plt.show()

# Plot histogram for each borough
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
for borough in df['BOROUGH'].dropna().unique():
    subset = df[df['BOROUGH'] == borough]
    plt.hist(subset['hour'], bins=24, alpha=0.5, label=borough)

plt.xlabel('Hour of Day')
plt.ylabel('Number of Crashes')
plt.title('Number of Crashes by Hour and Borough')
plt.legend(title='Borough')
plt.show()
```

# 3. Overlay Crash Locations on a Map of NYC
```{python}
import geopandas as gpd
from shapely.geometry import Point
import contextily as ctx

# Create a GeoDataFrame
geometry = [Point(xy) for xy in zip(df['LONGITUDE'], df['LATITUDE'])]
gdf = gpd.GeoDataFrame(df, geometry=geometry)
gdf.crs = "EPSG:4326"  # WGS 84

# Filter for NYC bounds (approximate bounds)
nyc_bounds = gdf.cx[-74.05:-73.85, 40.63:40.85]

# Reproject to Web Mercator
gdf_nyc = nyc_bounds.to_crs(epsg=3857)

# Plotting
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 12))
gdf_nyc.plot(ax=ax, marker='o', color='red', markersize=5, alpha=0.5)
ctx.add_basemap(ax, crs=gdf_nyc.crs.to_string())

plt.title("Crash Locations in New York City")
plt.xlabel("Longitude")
plt.ylabel("Latitude")
plt.show()
```
# 4. Create 'Severe' Variable and Construct Cross Table
```{python}
# Create the 'severe' variable
df['severe'] = ((df['NUMBER OF PERSONS INJURED'] > 0) | (df['NUMBER OF PERSONS KILLED'] > 0)).astype(int)

# Crosstab for severity vs borough
severity_borough_table = pd.crosstab(df['BOROUGH'], df['severe'])
print(severity_borough_table)

# Chi-square test
chi2, p, dof, expected = stats.chi2_contingency(severity_borough_table)
print(f"Chi-Square Statistic: {chi2}, P-value: {p}")

if p < 0.05:
    print("Reject the null hypothesis: Severity is associated with borough.")
else:
    print("Fail to reject the null hypothesis: No association between severity and borough.")
```
# 5. Merge Crash Data with ZIP Code Database
```{python}
zip_code_data = pd.read_csv('data/nypd_precincts.csv', encoding='latin1')  # Wasn't sure what to do with the encoding error so I googled it

df['ZIP CODE'] = df['ZIP CODE'].astype(str)
zip_code_data['Precinct'] = zip_code_data['Precinct'].astype(str)

merged_data = pd.merge(df, zip_code_data, left_on='ZIP CODE', right_on='Precinct', how='left')
print(merged_data.head())
```
